5005.title: Global maintenance gate starves settled-thread pruning
5005.rootCauseOneLine: A workspace-wide idle gate exits before any policy advance whenever another thread or interaction is busy.
5005.proposedFix: Select and recheck background-eligible threads inside each pruning transaction; preserve bounded batches, live pruning, and disruptive-maintenance gates.
5005.caveats: Production database size, throughput, and vacuum reclamation were not measured. Two clean runs were performed by the same agent.
